boundaries: Imported CIs are bound by positive object-pointer origins in actual saved check environments, then structural native keys and original per-module declaration selections.
A witness to one compiled symbol marks its historical source unit; it does not show that every line or generated member is necessary.
Stage2 structural-name and exact native-range correspondence is not creation provenance and is not promoted to an imported dependency witness.
No missing observation is classified unused; symbolic-name existence, compiler attributes, macro-only and other CI/runtime consumers remain open.
All physical_span_lines are historical raw LF spans; masked reported units remain separate. Changed historical files are never remapped.
Provenance is pinned-file path/marker classification; untraced and chain/agreement files are not certified handwritten. Historical source drift has its own bucket.
Cache contents are externally trusted; explicit queried artifact bytes and all producer/input/output hashes are receipt-bound.
settling_measurement: An isolated removal replay of the complete affected-root suite on an authorized valid baseline, recording native symbolic, macro and attribute dependencies.
verdict: No historical candidate receives an imported snapshot dependency witness or exact stage2 range correspondence in this measured corpus. This does not certify unusedness or deletability; full-root liveness remains unresolved.
